build_read_instruction_from_spec: build a ReadInstruction from a string spec like 'train[:33%]' to slice a dataset split
create_file_instructions_for_split: create FileInstructions for a dataset split by calling make_file_instructions with split infos and a ReadInstruction
read_arrow_table_from_file: read an Arrow table from a file using ArrowReader.read_table with optional in_memory flag
read_parquet_table_from_file: read a Parquet table from a file using ParquetReader._get_table_from_filename with skip and take parameters
convert_instruction_to_absolute: convert a ReadInstruction to absolute boundaries by calling to_absolute with a split name to length dict
